text:
Happy to. Two things I need before I can book it:

1. **When?** Next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) the calendar is dense; the free windows inside working hours (09:00–17:00) are:
   - Mon: 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
   - Tue: 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30
   - Wed: 10:00–10:30
   - Thu, Fri: no gaps at all
   If you want a longer slot (45–60 min) I'd have to move something.
2. **Who should be there?** Just you and me, or Sarah (`sarah-agent`) as well? I can ask her for her availability.

Tell me day/time and attendees and I'll book it and log it in the calendar.

Tuesday 11:00–11:30 works — please book that, and ask Sarah if she can make it; if she can't, Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is my fallback. I don't have the full attendee list in front of me, so hold the invitations until I've checked with the department office who else should be there.

Hi Sarah — alvarez-agent here, I manage Prof. Alvarez's calendar for CSE455.

He'd like a **CSE455 staff meeting next week, Tuesday 23 Nov, 11:00–11:30**. Can you make that slot?

If not, his fallback is **Wednesday 24 Nov, 10:00–10:30**. He's still checking with the department office who else should attend, so hold on the invitations for now — just let me know if you're available.
Hello — I'm scheduling the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. Could you tell me who normally should be invited (TA list and anyone else who should attend)? Thanks.

Booked and logged:

- **Tue 23 Nov, 11:00–11:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** (in the calendar, and under `## Log`: `BOOKED: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`).
- Asked Sarah whether she can make Tuesday; I'll tell you as soon as she answers, and if she can't I'll move it to Wednesday 10:00–10:30.
- No invitations sent — waiting for your attendee list from the department office.

Hello Professor Alvarez. I'm the department front office. I don't keep course rosters or a TA list — only the official room/meeting schedule — so I can't name invitees for a staff meeting, and I don't have access to anyone's private appointments or details.

What I do have for next week:
- CSE455 lecture: Mon 14:30-15:20, Tue 09:00-10:30, Fri 13:20-14:30
- CSE455 office hours: Mon 16:30-17:00, Tue 12:20-13:30 and 15:30-16:20, Wed 10:30-12:00, Fri 15:20-17:00
- CSE455 quiz section: Tue 16:20-17:00, Wed 13:30-14:20

For the invitation list, the current instructor and the course staff list in the department's records would be the place to check; I can't pull that together for you. Anything on rooms or times for next week, I'm glad to help.
Thanks — that's fine. I'll forward the attendee list once the department office gets back to me.
Perfect — send it whenever it arrives and I'll take care of the invitations.
Thanks — understood. I'll check the course staff list myself for the invitations. Nothing else needed from you for now.

The department office says it doesn't keep course rosters or a TA list, so no attendee list from there. Keep the meeting booked and the invitations unsent for now; I'll confirm who the CSE455 course staff are myself and get back to you — Sarah is the only one I can confirm so far.
You're welcome, Professor. The front office is here if anything else comes up.

Actually, change of plan: the department office has no course roster, so there's no list coming from them. I'll confirm the CSE455 course staff myself and send you the names — hold the invitations until then.

Understood — the CSE455 staff meeting stays **Tue 23 Nov, 11:00–11:30** as booked and logged, no invitations out. Sarah is the only confirmed attendee so far; I'm still waiting on her answer about the Tuesday slot (fallback Wed 10:00–10:30). Send the rest of the list whenever you have it and I'll do the invitations then.
Yes, got it — nothing goes out until you send me the names. Meeting stays Tue 23 Nov, 11:00–11:30.

Done for now: the CSE455 staff meeting is booked for Tue 23 Nov, 11:00–11:30 and logged. I've asked Sarah about that slot (fallback Wed 10:00–10:30) and I'm holding all invitations until you send the course-staff names.

Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. A pleasure to meet you.

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca, sha256 343650a40b0f7a4134536756ea5e28c822f7b21a3189d25ae09a8460cd8b843b). Accept the certificate on the first visit, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (so you can write and call me there), plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code so I log in. Would you like me to set any of those up?
- **Websites and services** — I can register my own accounts (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check appears.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
Thanks — good to meet you too. Nothing needed from you right now; I'll come to you when something comes up.

Hi — Sarah's assistant here. Tuesday 23 Nov 11:00–11:30 is taken (Seminar 09:50–11:10 runs into Lunch 11:10–12:10, so that slot is not free).

Wednesday 24 Nov 10:00–10:30 works — I've booked it and logged it. Not sending invitations yet, as you asked; tell me when the attendee list from the department is settled and I'll handle them.

Thanks — the fallback works. I've moved the CSE455 staff meeting to **Wednesday 24 Nov, 10:00–10:30** on Prof. Alvarez's calendar (Tuesday 11:00–11:30 released) and logged both changes.

One correction on the attendee list: the department office says it keeps no course rosters or TA lists, so nothing is coming from them. Prof. Alvarez is confirming the CSE455 course staff himself and will send me the names — Sarah is the only confirmed attendee so far. When the list is settled I'll send the invitations myself and let you know, so we don't both send them.
Perfect, matches my side. Wednesday 24 Nov 10:00–10:30 is on Sarah's calendar, nothing sent from here — you handle the invitations and I'll wait for the settled list.

Update from Sarah's assistant: **Tuesday 23 Nov 11:00–11:30 is not free for Sarah** (her seminar runs into lunch). She confirmed she's available **Wednesday 24 Nov 10:00–10:30**, your fallback.

So I've moved the CSE455 staff meeting to **Wed 24 Nov, 10:00–10:30** and logged it:
- `DELETED: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`
- `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`

Invitations are still on hold until you confirm the course staff. I also told Sarah's assistant that the department has no roster and that the names are coming from you, and that I'll send the invitations myself so we don't duplicate them.
Great — aligned. I'll send the invitations once Prof. Alvarez confirms the course staff, and let you know.
Thanks — that matches my fallback, so Wednesday 24 Nov 10:00–10:30 it is. Good call telling Sarah's assistant that the invitations stay with you.
Pleasure. Wed 24 Nov 10:00–10:30 is locked in; I'll send the invitations as soon as you send the names.
